subject: Post-call: Procurement readiness & invoice detail checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Francesca Rossi <f.rossi@atlashealth.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: Procurement readiness & invoice detail checklist

Hi Francesca —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a short checklist so your finance/procurement team can validate the path we discussed for the pilot: 

1) Commercial path options we outlined
   - Option A: Purchase Order (PO) to Redwood with Net 30 terms.
   - Option B: AWS Marketplace purchase (single-click, marketplace invoicing) — removes need for internal PO, but requires marketplace enrollment.

2) Invoice / billing details your team typically needs
   - Invoice format: PDF with line-item breakdown and VAT line.
   - Mandatory fields: Billing address, VAT/Tax ID, Purchase order number field, Remit-to instructions.
   - Preferred remit method: bank transfer (SEPA) or card for pilot depending on procurement preference.

3) Timing and docs
   - If going PO route: estimate 7–14 business days to issue a PO after SOW/quote signoff (your procurement dependent).
   - If marketplace: often same-week activation but requires marketplace account & PO reconciliation processes.

4) Attachments we need from you to proceed
   - Your PO template (so our finance team can populate invoice fields)
   - Any internal billing code / cost-centre to add to invoices

Can you confirm which path you prefer (PO vs marketplace) and attach the PO template if the PO route is preferred? Also please confirm the billing address and VAT number you want on the invoice so we can draft the pilot invoice to match your AP rules.

Next steps from Redwood: Jordan will confirm the exact invoice layout we can provide and Neha (billing ops) will confirm lead time for PO vs card processing. Once we have your PO template and billing details we’ll produce a sample invoice for review.

Thanks —

Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: Redwood_MSA_v1.2.pdf]
From: Francesca Rossi <f.rossi@atlashealth.io>

Cc: Marco Bianchi <m.bianchi@atlashealth.io>, Atlas Health Billing <billing@atlashealth.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:46:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement readiness & invoice detail checklist

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers from our side:

- Procurement path: we prefer the PO route for the pilot (internal policy for POs under €50k). Marketplace is interesting but procurement would still ask for a PO reconciliation.
- Net terms: Net 30.
- Billing address & VAT:
  Billing name: Atlas Health S.r.l.
  Billing address: Via Torino 14, 20123 Milano, Italy
  VAT ID: IT12345678901
- AP requires invoice as a single-page PDF with PO number field and our internal cost center on each line item.
- We attached our PO template for you to populate (see attached).

Please note: our procurement team also asks that the supplier's legal name and registered address are present on the invoice; I see you attached the MSA draft — we'll review that separately.

Appended: Atlas_PO_template.pdf (filled-in fields highlighted)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Francesca Rossi <f.rossi@atlashealth.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement readiness & invoice detail checklist

Thanks Francesca — that's perfect, and the PO template helps a lot. A couple of clarifications from billing ops side: 

- Invoice layout: we can produce a single-page PDF with line-items and your cost-center as requested. We will include: Redwood legal name (Redwood Inference Inc.), our registered address, invoice number, invoice date, PO number field, VAT breakdown, and a remit-to IBAN for SEPA.
- Net 30 will be honored.
- If you need a separate credit memo or alternate remit instructions (different bank), flag that now so we can add it to our finance profile.
- Regarding marketplace: if you want to pursue AWS Marketplace to avoid the PO turnaround in future, reach out and we can loop in our Marketplace ops lead — note that invoicing flows and reporting differ so AP will likely need a reconciliation process on their end.

I’ll have our billing ops team draft a sample invoice (using the PO template you provided) and share it in 1–2 business days.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Sent on behalf of Billing Ops]

Hi all —

Great — thanks for the quick response, Francesca. Next steps: 

1) Jordan/Neha: please draft the sample invoice using Atlas_PO_template.pdf and include the Redwood registered address and VAT breakdown. Share as a PDF for their AP review.
2) Francesca/Atlas: once you confirm the sample looks correct, please issue the PO (RH-9876 as the reference) and copy billing@atlashealth.io.
3) I'll schedule a 30-minute handoff with Atlas AP and Redwood Billing Ops to walk through the invoice fields and marketplace considerations (if they'd like). Proposed times: Mon 16 Aug 09:00 CEST or Tue 17 Aug 14:00 CEST — which works best?

I'll await the sample invoice and your preferred slot.

Thanks —
